messages:
lina: quick proposal — for multi-lang SDKs (py/ts/go) i want to standardize on a checkpointed window-scroll model for pagination instead of streaming cursors. rationale: simpler retry semantics across transports (http1 keepalive, http2, grpc-web) and easier to support server-side sharding.

kevin: +1 to the intent. can you sketch the client API shape? TS ergonomics are sensitive to extra objects.

lina: idea sketch: expose a paged iterator but return a light 'checkpoint' token with a tiny metadata header. e.g.
```json
{ "v":1, "t":"opaque", "h":"hint" }
```
client-visible token is opaque string but server can parse internally. API:
- python: for page in client.list_things(checkpoint=None, window=50):
- ts: for await (const page of client.listThings({checkpoint, window}))
- go: iters with Next(ctx) and Checkpoint()

maya: how do retries work if a page request fails mid-window? are we re-fetching last N items? sounds like we need deterministic window anchors.

lina: plan: server returns stable anchors per page (start_id, end_id) embedded in checkpoint. client retry semantics: if request fails, client re-requests checkpoint -> server responds with the same page or the next consistent window. we avoid re-streaming in-flight items.

sam: concern: this adds roundtrips for resume (checkpoint fetch) vs streaming resume which can be immediate. but checkpoint model lets us add server-side affinity/shard-routing easily. tradeoff seems OK for enterprise workloads.

kevin: on transport: grpc-web via envoy can't do long-lived bidi easily. with checkpoints we avoid needing bidi for resume. nice. any perf numbers?

lina: rough numbers: on p50 loads using window=100 we see 2-3% extra latency on cold resume vs cursor streaming, but tail stabilized more. overall token/cost similar.

maya: API detail: should we surface token schema version? above v1 helps future changes. but keep SDKs treating token as string to avoid breaking. servers should enforce token v mismatch error code.

kevin: TS example shape that remains ergonomic:
```ts
const iter = client.listThings({window: 100, checkpoint: prev});
for await (const page of iter) {
  // page.items: Thing[]
  // page.checkpoint: string
}
```
we keep page.checkpoint as opaque string. implement helpers in SDK for token introspection for advanced users.

sam: retries: recommend client default retry for GET pages only on idempotent failures (5xx / network). non-idempotent server ops must not use checkpoint resume. add explicit opt-in for optimistic re-fetch if server supports tombstones.

maya: test matrix we need: python/ts/go iteration, http1 vs http2 vs grpc-web, resume after leader failover, token-version-mismatch handling.

lina: agreed. i'll draft RFC with API sketches + test matrix. cc @kevin @maya for review. :sparkles:

ci-bot: CI pipeline for docs/rfc created — link: https://ci.internal/reports/1773334445
